title: Trader Diary: 1% Up & My Leverage Dreams
content:
💹 See BTC +1% and instantly open 10x long. 5 minutes later: “Why is my margin screaming louder than my alarm at 3 AM?”
💀 Close position at -0.3% and pretend I was “testing my stop‑loss strategy.”
lesson: Never let a 1% move dictate a 10x position – respect your risk, not the hype.
question: Who else turned a 1% rally into a heart‑rate monitor? Drop your worst FOMO story 👇
